description: Use to check one specific listing before recommending or connecting it: plans and prices with billing units, what it does, integrations, deployment (hosted / self_hosted / both / unknown, with evidence), licence (named licence only), liveness and how to connect (website, docs, MCP endpoint with a copy-paste config_snippet, A2A agent card, API, install). Fields are null when the vendor publishes nothing; nothing is guessed. price_applies_to flags a stored price that belongs to the vendor's platform rather than this connector. Optional price_history returns dated plan prices. reported_success stays null until 5+ distinct reporters in 90 days; after actually using a listing, call report_outcome.

history_days.description: Window for price_history in days (1–400, default 90).

plan.description: Optional plan name filter for price_history.

price_history.description: Optional (1.17.0): include this provider's dated plan prices from Agentery's stored observations — periods at one published price, changes, coverage gaps, promotion/anomaly flags. Dates are observation dates, not necessarily when the vendor changed the price; prices stay in their original currency.

provider_id.description: The provider_id/handle returned by search_providers or compare_providers

name: get_provider_profile
